input.quote: The Licensee shall calculate the license fee payable to the Licensor for each month based on the Monthly Notional Volume bands for that pay period and shall pay the Licensor accordingly.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no minimum purchase or volume commitment on Licensee and contains no take-or-pay, monthly minimum, shortfall or volume-cap mechanic (searches for "minimum", "shortfall", "take or pay", "commit" and "volume" return nothing responsive). Licensee's user fees are keyed entirely to actual usage: the fee table's lowest Monthly Notional Volume band starts at zero ("0-10 US$7.50"), and Article V.III(b) requires Licensee only to calculate and pay based on the volume actually traded in that pay period. The only fixed charge is $2,500 per month for the Technical Support Services Licensee ordered, and Article VII(d) confirms "there shall be no additional fees payable by the Licensee to the Licensor for technical support services", so Licensee pays only for usage or ordered services. This meets the preferred position, so no redline is proposed. Two minor points noted for the rationale only, not as MINCOMMIT deviations: the drafting error in p0070 refers to the amount payable by "the Licensor" (evidently intended as Licensee), and the audit-cost shift at a 5% discrepancy (p0064) sits under audit rather than commitment terms.
